meta.title: Find and sell car spare parts

hero.title: Need a car part? Got one to sell?
hero.lead: Ksmarting Auto connects people who are looking for spare parts with people who have them. Post a request or list your own parts, and get matched.
hero.needText: Post a request with your car and the part you want. Sellers who have it get in touch.
hero.haveText: List what you have with photos and a price. Buyers looking for it find you.
hero.imgSearchAlt: Search screen of the Ksmarting Auto app
hero.imgProductAlt: Product page in the Ksmarting Auto app
hero.imgOptionsAlt: Options screen in the Ksmarting Auto app

steps.title: Post a request
steps.text: Say which part, and your car's make, model and year.

steps.title: Get responses
steps.text: Sellers with a matching part send you their offer.

steps.title: Agree and collect
steps.text: Chat, confirm the price and arrange pickup or delivery.

steps.title: List your product
steps.text: Add photos, condition, price and location.

steps.title: Get matched
steps.text: Your listing shows up for people searching or requesting it.

steps.title: Sell
steps.text: Reply to buyers and close the deal.

features.title: Made for the parts you actually need

items.title: Part requests
items.text: Ask for exactly what you need, even when no one has listed it yet.

items.title: Seller listings
items.text: Post used or new parts and reach buyers without a shop.

items.title: Search by car
items.text: Filter by make, model and year to find parts that fit.

items.title: Direct contact
items.text: Buyers and sellers talk to each other and agree the terms themselves.

data.title: What information goes into the system

rows: Part wanted, car make, model and year, notes, area, phone number

data.outro: Requests and listings are matched by part name and car details, so the more complete they are, the faster you get a match.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.text: Questions, feedback or a problem with a listing? Send us an email.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.effective: Effective date: September 30, 2026. This policy explains what information the Ksmarting Auto app and this website collect, how we use it and the choices you have. By using Ksmarting Auto you agree to this policy.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Ksmarting Auto is an app that connects people who need car spare parts with people who have them. You can contact us at {email}.

sections.title: Information we collect

items.label: Account details:
items.text: your name, email address, phone number and password (stored in protected form).

items.label: Requests and listings:
items.text: the part you want or sell, car make, model and year, condition, price, notes, the area you enter, and the photos you upload.

items.label: Messages:
items.text: what you send to other users through the app.

items.label: Device and usage data:
items.text: device type, app version and error logs, used to keep the app working and secure.

after: We do not collect payment card details in the app. Buyers and sellers agree on payment between themselves.

items.label: Camera and photos:
items.text: only to let you add pictures to a listing or request.

items.label: Notifications:
items.text: only to tell you about replies and matches. You can turn them off in your phone settings.
To create and manage your account.
To match part requests with listings and connect buyers with sellers.
To send you replies, matches and important service messages.
To prevent fraud and abuse, and to fix problems.
To follow the law when required.

sections.title: Who can see your information

items.text: Other users: listings, including photos, price, area and contact details you choose to show, are visible to app users. Requests are visible to sellers who reply.
Service providers who host our data and help run the app. They may only use it to provide their service to us.
Authorities, when the law requires it.

after: We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your information while your account is active. When you delete your account, we delete your data as described in the {link}, except records we must keep by law.

items.text: You can view and edit your details and listings in the app.
You can remove any request or listing at any time.
You can ask for a copy of your data or ask us to delete your account by emailing {email}.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical measures to protect your information. No system is completely secure, so please use a strong password and do not share it. Meet other users in safe places and check parts before you pay.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: Ksmarting Auto is not meant for children under 18, and we do not knowingly collect their information. If you think a child has given us information, email us and we will delete it.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy. We will change the effective date above and, for big changes, tell you in the app.
